title: FinEqs - reducing equations defining a subset of n-space over a finite field
abstract: Formalizes the finite-field equation-reduction theorem and sharpness examples.

informal.LeanPool.Fineqs.theorem_1: Reduces equations on a small finite set to at most n equations in the same span.
informal.LeanPool.Fineqs.prop_1: Shows the cardinality bound in the reduction theorem is sharp.
informal.LeanPool.Fineqs.corollary_2: Applies the reduction theorem to affine space over a finite field.
informal.LeanPool.Fineqs.corollary_3: Applies the reduction theorem to nonempty projective zero loci.
informal.LeanPool.Fineqs.remark_example: Shows n - 1 coordinate-function combinations have at least q common zeros.
